0n1unuy1588hvSELECT DISTINCT LP.LP_PROP_NO, LCI.LCI_CUST_NAME AS Custname, LO.LO_NAME, (SELECT LGM_STATE_NAME FROM LPSTP_STATE_CITY_MASTER WHERE LGM_STATE_CODE = LO_STATE AND LO_CITY = LGM_CITY_CODE) AS statename, NVL((SELECT LLV_OPTION_DESC FROM LPMAS_LISTOFVALUES, LPCOM_CASE_DET_SALES WHERE LPCDS_PROP_NO = LP_PROP_NO AND LLV_HEADER = 'typeofcase' AND LLV_OPTION_VAL = LPCDS_CASE_TYPE), ' ') AS casetype, TO_CHAR(LP.LP_CREATED_ON, 'dd-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS') AS LP_CREATED_ON, LP.LP_CREATED_BY, LSD.LSD_RM_EMP_NAME, LO.LO_SOL_ID, (SELECT CASE WHEN ((SELECT LBV_DENOM FROM LPMAS_BIZ_VERTICAL WHERE LBV_ROW_ID = :1 ) = 'L') THEN ROUND((SUM(NVL(LF_SALES_RECMD, LF_PROPOSED_LIMIT)) / 100000), 2) WHEN ((SELECT LBV_DENOM FROM LPMAS_BIZ_VERTICAL WHERE LBV_ROW_ID = :2 ) = 'C') THEN ROUND((SUM(NVL(LF_SALES_RECMD, LF_PROPOSED_LIMIT)) / 10000000), 2) WHEN ((SELECT LBV_DE NOM FROM LPMAS_BIZ_VERTICAL WHERE LBV_ROW_ID = :3 ) = 'A') THEN ROUND((SUM(NVL(LF_SALES_RECMD, LF_PROPOSED_LIMIT))), 0) END FROM lpcom_facilities WHERE lf_prop_no = LP_PROP_NO AND LF_FAC_LEVEL = '1' GROUP BY lf_prop_no) AS loanamount, (SELECT LBV_BIZ_VERTICAL FROM LPMAS_BIZ_VERTICAL WHERE LBV_ROW_ID = LSD_BSS_VERTICAL) AS businessvertical, TO_CHAR(LOM_RECVD_TIME, 'dd-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS') AS LOM_RECVD_TIME, NVL(CASE WHEN LF.LF_FAC_SALESTATUS = 'PA' THEN 'Approved' WHEN LF.LF_FAC_SALESTATUS = 'PR' THEN 'Rejected' WHEN LF.LF_FAC_SALESTATUS = 'PW' THEN 'Withdrawn' WHEN LF.LF_FAC_SALESTATUS = 'CA' THEN 'Account Created' ELSE 'On-Process' END, 'On-Process') AS fac_status, LP.LP_SL_REF_NO, (SELECT LISTAGG(LSF_FAC_DESC, ' - ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY LSF_FAC_ID) FROM (SELECT LSF_FAC_DESC, LSF_FAC_ID FROM LPSTP_FACILITY WHERE LSF_FAC_ID IN (LPD.LPD_PRD_MAIN_CAT, LPD.LPD_PRD_SUB_CAT))) AS Product_id, CASE WHEN LP.LP_OPS_REWORK = 'Y' THEN 'Rework' ELSE 'Fresh' END AS opsStatus FROM L PCOM_PROPOSAL LP LEFT JOIN LPCOM_PROP_PARTIES LPP ON LP.LP_PROP_NO = LPP.LPP_PROP_NO AND LPP.LPP_BORROWER = 'Y' AND LPP.LPP_BORR_TYPE = :4 LEFT JOIN LPCOM_CUST_INFO LCI ON LPP.LPP_CUST_ID_NEW = LCI.LCI_CUST_ID LEFT JOIN LPSTP_ORGANISATIONS LO ON LP.LP_ORG_CODE = LO.LO_ORG_ID LEFT JOIN LPCOM_SOURCING_DET LSD ON LP.LP_PROP_NO = LSD.LSD_PROP_NO LEFT JOIN LPCOM_OTHER_MAILBOX LOM ON LP.LP_PROP_NO = LOM.LOM_PROP_NO AND LOM.LOM_FRWD_TIME IS NULL LEFT JOIN LPCOM_FACILITIES LF ON LP.LP_PROP_NO = LF.LF_PROP_NO LEFT JOIN LPSTP_PRODUCT_DET LPD ON LF.LF_PROD_ID = LPD.LPD_PROD_NEW_ID LEFT JOIN LPCOM_PROP_LOCATION LPL ON LPL.LPL_PROP_NO = LP.LP_PROP_NO JOIN LPSTP_USER_LOCATION LUL ON (LUL.LUL_ORG_ID IN (LPL.LPL_LEVEL_1, LPL.LPL_LEVEL_2, LPL.LPL_LEVEL_3, LPL.LPL_LEVEL_4, LPL.LPL_LEVEL_5, LPL.LPL_LEVEL_6, LPL.LPL_LEVEL_7, LPL.LPL_LEVEL_8)) WHERE LP.LP_BIZ_VERTICAL = :5 AND LOM.LOM_INBOX_TYPE = :6 AND LOM.LOM_SENDBACK_FLAG IS NULL AND LUL.LUL_USER_ID = :7 AND LUL.LUL_BIZ_VERTICAL = LP.LP_BIZ_ VERTICAL AND LP.LP_STATUS NOT IN ('CA', 'PR', 'CL') ORDER BY TO_DATE(LOM_RECVD_TIME, 'dd-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS') DESC

20mx2v7h5fqxqDECLARE job BINARY_INTEGER := :job; next_date TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE := :mydate; broken BOOLEAN := FALSE; job_name VARCHAR2(128) := :job_name; job_subname VARCHAR2(128) := :job_subname; job_owner VARCHAR2(128) := :job_owner; job_start TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE := :job_start; job_scheduled_start TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE := :job_scheduled_start; window_start TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE := :window_start; window_end TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE := :window_end; chain_id VARCHAR2(14) := :chainid; credential_owner VARCHAR2(128) := :credown; credential_name VARCHAR2(128) := :crednam; destination_owner VARCHAR2(128) := :destown; destination_name VARCHAR2(128) := :destnam; job_dest_id varchar2(14) := :jdestid; log_id number := :log_id; BEGIN BEGIN RAJESH.DMS_UPLOAD_PROCESS.KYC_METADATA_INSERT(); END; :mydate := next_date; IF broken THEN :b := 1; EL SE :b := 0; END IF; END;

22mus1qj69uuzSELECT Distinct LP.LP_PROP_NO, LCI.LCI_CUST_NAME AS Custname, LO.LO_NAME, (select LGM_STATE_NAME from LPSTP_STATE_CITY_MASTER where LGM_STATE_CODE=LO_STATE AND LO_CITY=LGM_CITY_CODE) as statename, nvl((select LLV_OPTION_DESC from LPMAS_LISTOFVALUES, LPCOM_CASE_DET_SALES where LPCDS_PROP_NO=LP_PROP_NO and LLV_HEADER='typeofcase' and LLV_OPTION_VAL=LPCDS_CASE_TYPE), ' ') as casetype, TO_CHAR(LP.LP_CREATED_ON , 'dd-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS') AS LP_CREATED_ON, LP.LP_CREATED_BY, LSD.LSD_RM_EMP_NAME, LO.LO_SOL_ID, (select case when ((select LBV_DENOM from LPMAS_BIZ_VERTICAL where LBV_ROW_ID=:1 )='L') then round (( sum(NVL(LF_SALES_RECMD, LF_PROPOSED_LIMIT))/100000), 2) when ((select LBV_DENOM from LPMAS_BIZ_VERTICAL where LBV_ROW_ID=:2 )='C') then round(( sum(NVL(LF_SALES_RECMD, LF_PROPOSED_LIMIT))/10000000), 2) when ((select LBV_DENOM from LPMAS_BIZ_VE RTICAL where LBV_ROW_ID=:3 )='A') then round((sum(NVL(LF_SALES_RECMD, LF_PROPOSED_LIMIT))), 0) end from lpcom_facilities where lf_prop_no=LP_PROP_NO and LF_FAC_LEVEL='1' group by lf_prop_no ) as loanamount, (select LBV_BIZ_VERTICAL from LPMAS_BIZ_VERTICAL where LBV_ROW_ID=LSD_BSS_VERTICAL) as businessvertical, TO_CHAR(LM.LM_RECVD_TIME, 'dd-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS') AS LM_RECVD_TIME, NVL(CASE WHEN LF.LF_FAC_SALESTATUS='PA' THEN 'Approved' WHEN LF.LF_FAC_SALESTATUS='PR' THEN 'Rejected' WHEN LF.LF_FAC_SALESTATUS='PW' THEN 'Withdrawn' WHEN LF.LF_FAC_SALESTATUS='CA' THEN 'Account Created' else 'On-Process' END, 'On-Process') AS fac_status, LWF.LWF_AUTO_PICKUP , LSD.LSD_KLEAD_ID, LSD.LSD_LEAD_CREATEDBY_CODE, LP.LP_SL_REF_NO, (select listagg(LWF_FLOW_DESC, ', ') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY LWF_FLOW_ID) from LPSTP_WF_FLOWPOINT where LWF_FLOW_ID =LWF.LWF_FLOWPOINT) as flow_point, (select listagg(LSF_FAC_DESC, ' - ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY LSF_FAC_ID) FROM (select LSF_FAC_DESC, LSF_FAC_ID from L PSTP_FACILITY where LSF_FAC_ID in ( LPD.LPD_PRD_MAIN_CAT, LPD.LPD_PRD_SUB_CAT))) as Product_id, case when LP.LP_OPS_REWORK='Y' then 'Rework' else 'Fresh' END AS opsStatus, case when LP.LP_RENEW_FLAG='Y' then 'Yes' else 'NO' END AS renewal FROM LPCOM_PROPOSAL LP LEFT JOIN LPCOM_PROP_PARTIES LPP ON LP.LP_PROP_NO=LPP.LPP_PROP_NO AND LPP.LPP_BORROWER='Y' AND LPP.LPP_BORR_TYPE=:4 LEFT JOIN LPCOM_CUST_INFO LCI ON LPP.LPP_CUST_ID_NEW=LCI.LCI_CUST_ID LEFT JOIN LPSTP_ORGANISATIONS LO ON LP.LP_ORG_CODE=LO.LO_ORG_ID LEFT JOIN LPCOM_SOURCING_DET LSD ON LP.LP_PROP_NO=LSD.LSD_PROP_NO LEFT JOIN LPCOM_MAILBOX LM ON LP.LP_PROP_NO=LM.LM_PROP_NO AND LM.LM_FRWD_TIME IS NULL AND LM_ACCESS_FLAG!='M' left join LPSTP_WF_FLOWS LWF on LM.LM_FLOW_ID=LWF.LWF_FLOWPOINT_ID LEFT JOIN LPCOM_FACILITIES LF ON LP.LP_PROP_NO=LF.LF_PROP_NO LEFT JOIN LPSTP_PRODUCT_DET LPD ON LF.LF_PROD_ID=LPD.LPD_PROD_NEW_ID LEFT JOIN LPCOM_PROP_LOCATION LPL ON LPL.LPL_PROP_NO = LP.LP_PROP_NO JOIN LPSTP_USER_LOCATION LUL ON (LUL.LUL_ORG _ID IN (LPL.LPL_LEVEL_1, LPL.LPL_LEVEL_2, LPL.LPL_LEVEL_3, LPL.LPL_LEVEL_4, LPL.LPL_LEVEL_5, LPL.LPL_LEVEL_6, LPL.LPL_LEVEL_7, LPL.LPL_LEVEL_8)) WHERE LP.LP_PROP_HOLDER=:5 AND LP.LP_BIZ_VERTICAL=:6 AND LM.LM_ACCESS_FLAG != 'M' AND LM.LM_TO_USR=LP.LP_PROP_HOLDER AND LM.LM_TYPE=:7 AND LUL.LUL_USER_ID = :8 AND LUL.LUL_BIZ_VERTICAL = LP.LP_BIZ_VERTICAL AND LP.LP_STATUS NOT IN ('CA', 'PR', 'CL') ORDER By to_date(LM_RECVD_TIME, 'dd-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS') Desc

2at73yvm0y1nvWITH UniqueRows AS (SELECT sqlvw.sql_id, sqlvw.PARSING_SCHEMA_NAME, hstsql.plan_hash_value AS OldHashValue, sqlvw.plan_hash_value AS CurrntHashValue, hstsql.OPTIMIZER_COST AS oldCost, sqlvw.OPTIMIZER_COST AS CurrntCost, ABS(NVL(sqlvw.OPTIMIZER_COST, 0) - NVL(hstsql.OPTIMIZER_COST, 0)) AS CostDifference, sqlvw.sql_text, sqlvw.sql_id || '_' || hstsql.plan_hash_value || '_' || sqlvw.plan_hash_value || '_' || ABS(NVL(sqlvw.OPTIMIZER_COST, 0) - NVL(hstsql.OPTIMIZER_COST, 0)) AS primarycolumn FROM (SELECT DISTINCT sql_id, plan_hash_value, OPTIMIZER_COST, sql_text, PARSING_SCHEMA_NAME FROM v$sql) sqlvw JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT sql_id, plan_hash_value, OPTIMIZER_COST, snap_id FROM DBA_HIST_SQLSTAT WHERE snap_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT snap_id FROM dba_hist_snapshot WHERE BEGIN_INTERVAL_TIME >= sysdate - 1)) hstsql ON sqlvw.sql_id = hstsql.sql_id WH ERE sqlvw.plan_hash_value <> hstsql.plan_hash_value) SELECT sql_id, MIN(PARSING_SCHEMA_NAME) AS PARSING_SCHEMA_NAME, OldHashValue, CurrntHashValue, MIN(oldCost) AS oldCost, MIN(CurrntCost) AS CurrntCost, MIN(CostDifference) AS CostDifference, MIN(sql_text) AS sql_text, primarycolumn FROM UniqueRows GROUP BY sql_id, OldHashValue, CurrntHashValue, CostDifference, primarycolumn ORDER BY sql_id FETCH FIRST 100 ROWS ONLY
2b5hy6y2rg37vSELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LP.LP_PROP_NO) AS count FROM LPCOM_PROPOSAL LP LEFT JOIN LPCOM_MAILBOX LM ON LP.LP_PROP_NO = LM.LM_PROP_NO LEFT JOIN LPCOM_SECURITIES LS ON LM.LM_REFERENCE_ID = LS.LS_SEC_ID LEFT JOIN LPCOM_TECH_VALUATION LTV ON LM.LM_REFERENCE_ID = LTV.LTV_COLLATERAL_ID LEFT JOIN LPCOM_SAFEKEEPING_RECORDS LSR ON LM.LM_REFERENCE_ID = LSR.LSR_SECID WHERE LS.LS_DELETE != 'Y' AND LM.LM_ACCESS_FLAG != 'M' AND LM.LM_FRWD_TIME IS NOT NULL AND LP.LP_PROP_NO IN ( SELECT LPL.LPL_PROP_NO FROM LPSTP_USER_LOCATION LUL JOIN LPCOM_PROP_LOCATION LPL ON ( LUL.LUL_ORG_ID = LPL.LPL_LEVEL_1 OR LUL.LUL_ORG_ID = LPL.LPL_LEVEL_2 OR LUL.LUL_ORG_ID = LPL.LPL_LEVEL_3 OR LUL.LUL_ORG_ID = LPL.LPL_LEVEL_4 OR LUL.LUL_ORG_ID = LPL.LPL_LEVEL_5 OR LUL.LUL_ORG_ID = LPL.LPL_LEVEL_6 OR LUL.LUL_ORG_ID = LPL.LPL_LEVEL_7 OR LUL.LUL_ORG_ID = LPL.LPL_LEVEL_8 ) WHERE LUL.LUL_USER_ID = :1 AND LUL.LUL_BIZ_VERTICAL = LP.LP_BIZ_VERTICAL AND LP.LP_PROP_NO = LPL.LPL_PROP_NO) AND LP.LP_BIZ_VERTICAL = :2 AND LM.LM_TL_FLAG = :3 AND LP.LP_STATUS NOT IN ('CA', 'PR', 'CL') AND ((LM.LM_TL_FLAG='T' AND LM.LM_REFERENCE_ID = LTV.LTV_COLLATERAL_ID AND LTV.LTV_VALUATION_STTS='A' AND LTV.LTV_TECH_VERIFY IS NULL AND LTV.LTV_TECH_SENDBACK IS NULL) OR (LM.LM_TL_FLAG = 'L' AND LM.LM_REFERENCE_ID = LSR.LSR_SECID AND LSR.LSR_USER_FLAG = 'L' AND LSR.LSR_STATUS='A' AND LSR.LSR_LEGAL_VERIFY IS NULL AND LSR.LSR_LEGAL_SENDBACK IS NULL))

6d951ucz5t45xSELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LP.LP_PROP_NO) AS count FROM LPCOM_PROPOSAL LP LEFT JOIN LPCOM_MAILBOX LM ON LP.LP_PROP_NO = LM.LM_PROP_NO LEFT JOIN LPCOM_SECURITIES LS ON LM.LM_REFERENCE_ID = LS.LS_SEC_ID LEFT JOIN LPCOM_TECH_VALUATION LTV ON LM.LM_REFERENCE_ID = LTV.LTV_COLLATERAL_ID LEFT JOIN LPCOM_SAFEKEEPING_RECORDS LSR ON LM.LM_REFERENCE_ID = LSR.LSR_SECID WHERE LS.LS_DELETE != 'Y' AND LM.LM_ACCESS_FLAG != 'M' AND LM.LM_FRWD_TIME IS NULL AND LP.LP_PROP_NO IN ( SELECT LPL.LPL_PROP_NO FROM LPSTP_USER_LOCATION LUL JOIN LPCOM_PROP_LOCATION LPL ON ( LUL.LUL_ORG_ID = LPL.LPL_LEVEL_1 OR LUL.LUL_ORG_ID = LPL.LPL_LEVEL_2 OR LUL.LUL_ORG_ID = LPL.LPL_LEVEL_3 OR LUL.LUL_ORG_ID = LPL.LPL_LEVEL_4 OR LUL.LUL_ORG_ID = LPL.LPL_LEVEL_5 OR LUL.LUL_ORG_ID = LPL.LPL_LEVEL_6 OR LUL.LUL_ORG_ID = LPL.LPL_LEVEL_7 OR LUL.LUL_ORG_ID = LPL.LPL_LEVEL_8 ) WHERE LUL.LUL_USER_ID = :1 AND L UL.LUL_BIZ_VERTICAL = LP.LP_BIZ_VERTICAL AND LP.LP_PROP_NO = LPL.LPL_PROP_NO) AND LP.LP_BIZ_VERTICAL = :2 AND LM.LM_TL_FLAG = :3 AND LP.LP_STATUS NOT IN ('CA', 'PR', 'CL') AND ((LM.LM_TL_FLAG = 'T' AND LTV.LTV_COLLATERAL_ID IS NULL) OR (LM.LM_TL_FLAG = 'L' AND (LSR.LSR_SECID IS NULL OR (LSR.LSR_SECID IS NOT NULL AND LSR.LSR_USER_FLAG != 'L'))))

cgky22310n1hgselect object_type, owner, object_name, rank from ( select object_type, owner, object_name, 0 rank from all_objects where object_name = :NAME and UPPER(owner) = nvl(:OWNER, :SCHEMA_CONTEXT) and object_type not in ( 'SYNONYM' ) union all select ao.object_type, ao.owner, ao.object_name, decode(UPPER(syn.owner), nvl(:OWNER, :SCHEMA_CONTEXT), 10, 20) from all_objects ao, all_synonyms syn where ao.owner = syn.table_owner and ao.object_name = syn.table_name and syn.synonym_name = :NAME and ( UPPER(syn.owner) = nvl(:OWNER, :SCHEMA_CONTEXT) OR UPPER(syn.owner) = nvl(:OWNER, 'PUBLIC') ) ) where ((:BODY_WHERE='Y') OR (object_type not in ('PACKAGE BODY'))) AND rownum < 100 order by rank, CASE object_type WHEN 'TABLE' THEN 0 WHEN 'VIEW' THEN 1 WHEN 'INDEX' THEN 2 WHEN 'PACKAGE' THEN 3 WHEN 'PACKAGE BODY' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END
cgnpmckc5t8hcSELECT TO_CHAR(LP.LP_CREATED_ON, 'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS AM') as createdate, LO.LO_NAME as Branch, LP.LP_PROP_NO as prop, CUST.CBS_ID as cbsid, IND.LCI_FIRST_NAME||' '||IND.LCI_LAST_NAME as name, PD.LPD_CBS_CODE as cbscode, CBS.CACC_LOAN_ACCNO as cbsAccountno, NVL(LF.LF_SALES_RECMD, LF.LF_SANC_LIMIT) as loanamount, LF.LF_ROI as Interest, (SELECT sum(LGD_GRSS_WEIGH) FROM LPCOM_GOLD_DETAILS where LGD_PROP_NO =LP.LP_PROP_NO) AS Grossweight, (SELECT sum(LGD_DEDUCTION) FROM LPCOM_GOLD_DETAILS where LGD_PROP_NO =LP.LP_PROP_NO) AS Depreciation, (SELECT sum(LGD_NET_WEIGH) FROM LPCOM_GOLD_DETAILS where LGD_PROP_NO =LP.LP_PROP_NO) AS Netweight, LP.LP_CREATED_BY AS ReferredBy, CASE WHEN LF.LF_MODE_OF_DISB='1' THEN 'Fund Transfer' WHEN LF.LF_MODE_OF_DISB='2' THEN 'Cash Disburement' ELSE '' END AS PAYMENT_MODE, CASE WHEN LP.LP_STATUS ='OP' THEN 'Open Pending' WHEN LP.LP_STATUS ='PR' THEN 'REJECTED' WHEN LP.LP_STATUS ='PA' THEN 'APPROVED' WHEN LP.LP_STATUS ='CA' THEN 'DISBURSED' WHEN LP.LP_STATUS ='CL' THEN 'CLOSED' ELSE '' END ApplicationStatus FROM LPCOM_PROPOSAL LP LEFT OUTER JOIN LPSTP_ORGANISATIONS LO ON LO.LO_ORG_ID=LP.LP_ORG_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN LPCOM_FACILITIES LF ON LF.LF_PROP_NO =LP.LP_PROP_NO AND LF.LF_FAC_LEVEL='1' LEFT OUTER JOIN LPSTP_PRODUCT_DET PD ON PD.LPD_PROD_NEW_ID=LF.LF_PROD_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN LPCOM_PROP_PARTIES LPP ON LP.LP_PROP_NO=LPP.LPP_PROP_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN LPCOM_CUST_DATA_IND IND ON IND.LCI_NEW_ID=LPP.LPP_CUST_ID_NEW LEFT OUTER JOIN CBS_CUSTCREATE_STATUS CUST ON CUST.CBS_APPNO=LP.LP_PROP_NO AND CUST.CBS_APPID=LPP.LPP_CUST_ID_NEW LEFT OUTER JOIN CBS_ACCCREATE_STATUS CBS ON CBS.CACC_APPNO=LP.LP_PROP_NO AND CBS.CACC_STATUS='S' WHERE LP.LP_BIZ_VERTICAL='16' and Lo.LO_ORG_ID =:1 and lf.LF_FAC_STATUS IN (:2 ) and TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(LP.LP_CREATED_ON, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'DD/MM/YYYY') between TO_DATE(:3 , 'DD/MM/YYYY') and TO_D ATE(:4 , 'DD/MM/YYYY') and nvl(lf.LF_SALES_RECMD, lf.LF_PROPOSED_LIMIT) between :5 and :6
d0wkwqfvgu26fWITH LastEntries AS ( SELECT LM.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LM.LM_PROP_NO ORDER BY LM.LM_ROW_ID DESC) AS rn FROM LPCOM_MAILBOX LM LEFT JOIN LPCOM_TECH_VALUATION LTV ON LM.LM_REFERENCE_ID = LTV.LTV_COLLATERAL_ID LEFT JOIN LPCOM_SAFEKEEPING_RECORDS LSR ON LM.LM_REFERENCE_ID = LSR.LSR_SECID WHERE LM.LM_FRWD_TIME IS NOT NULL and lm.LM_TL_FLAG = :1 AND ((LM.LM_TL_FLAG='T' AND LM.LM_REFERENCE_ID = LTV.LTV_COLLATERAL_ID AND LTV.LTV_VALUATION_STTS='A' AND LTV.LTV_TECH_VERIFY IS NULL AND LTV.LTV_TECH_SENDBACK IS NULL) OR (LM.LM_TL_FLAG = 'L' AND LM.LM_REFERENCE_ID = LSR.LSR_SECID AND LSR.LSR_USER_FLAG = 'L' AND LSR.LSR_STATUS='A' AND LSR.LSR_LEGAL_VERIFY IS NULL AND LSR.LSR_LEGAL_SENDBACK IS NULL)) ) SELECT DISTINCT LP.LP_PROP_NO, LCI.LCI_CUST_NAME AS Custname, LO.LO_NAME, (SELECT LGM_STATE_NAME FROM LPSTP_STATE_CITY_MASTER WHERE LGM_STATE_CODE = LO_ STATE AND LO_CITY = LGM_CITY_CODE) AS statename, NVL((SELECT LLV_OPTION_DESC FROM LPMAS_LISTOFVALUES, LPCOM_CASE_DET_SALES WHERE LPCDS_PROP_NO = LP_PROP_NO AND LLV_HEADER = 'typeofcase' AND LLV_OPTION_VAL = LPCDS_CASE_TYPE), ' ') AS casetype, TO_CHAR(LP.LP_CREATED_ON, 'dd-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS') AS LP_CREATED_ON, LP.LP_CREATED_BY, LSD.LSD_RM_EMP_NAME, LO.LO_SOL_ID, (SELECT CASE WHEN ((SELECT LBV_DENOM FROM LPMAS_BIZ_VERTICAL WHERE LBV_ROW_ID = :2 ) = 'L') THEN ROUND((SUM(NVL(LF_SALES_RECMD, LF_PROPOSED_LIMIT)) / 100000), 2) WHEN ((SELECT LBV_DENOM FROM LPMAS_BIZ_VERTICAL WHERE LBV_ROW_ID = :3 ) = 'C') THEN ROUND((SUM(NVL(LF_SALES_RECMD, LF_PROPOSED_LIMIT)) / 10000000), 2) WHEN ((SELECT LBV_DENOM FROM LPMAS_BIZ_VERTICAL WHERE LBV_ROW_ID = :4 ) = 'A') THEN ROUND((SUM(NVL(LF_SALES_RECMD, LF_PROPOSED_LIMIT))), 0) END FROM lpcom_facilities WHERE lf_prop_no = LP_PROP_NO AND LF_FAC_LEVEL = '1' GROUP BY lf_prop_no) AS loanamount, (SELECT LBV_BIZ_VERTICAL FROM LPMAS_BIZ_VERTICAL W HERE LBV_ROW_ID = LSD_BSS_VERTICAL) AS businessvertical, TO_CHAR(LM_RECVD_TIME, 'dd-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS') AS LM_RECVD_TIME, NVL(CASE WHEN LF.LF_FAC_SALESTATUS = 'PA' THEN 'Approved' WHEN LF.LF_FAC_SALESTATUS = 'PR' THEN 'Rejected' WHEN LF.LF_FAC_SALESTATUS = 'PW' THEN 'Withdrawn' LPP.LPP_CUST_ID_NEW = LCI.LCI_CUST_ID LEFT JOIN LPSTP_ORGANISATIONS LO ON LP.LP_ORG_CODE = LO.LO_ORG_ID LEFT JOIN LPCOM_SOURCING_DET LSD ON LP.LP_PROP_NO = LSD.LSD_PROP_NO LEFT JOIN LastEntries LM ON LPSTP_PRODUCT_DET LPD ON LF.LF_PROD_ID = LPD.LPD_PROD_NEW_ID LEFT JOIN LPCOM_SECURITIES LS ON LM.LM_REFERENCE_ID = LS.LS_SEC_ID AND LS_DELETE != 'Y' WHERE LP.LP_BIZ_VERTICAL = :6 AND LM.LM_TL_FLAG =
